propositions: An open or in_progress bug with a caused_by edge into an epic subtree must deterministically block epic close, like the direct-children gate, with a teaching message to fix, re-parent, or dispute the link.

The candidate filter identifies open/in_progress bugs created after the epic's first in_progress transition (using retired events) or linked any-relation any-depth to the epic subtree (both directions), capped at 32 with overflow tallied.

A single-turn forced-choice haiku screen (A: defect in deliverable, B: pre-existing/adjacent, C: unrelated) evaluates forwarded candidates using model-class config and shared cache, with A-verdicts forwarded as compact evidence (max 8 full rows + title-only overflow) inside the precheck-assembled context.

The verifier blocks only defect-in-deliverable bugs with no recorded disposition: satisfactory disposition is either a supersedes/duplicates link to the epic subtree or a reasoned pre-existence/supersession assertion in bug prose; bare 'out of scope' does not qualify.

Screen output must ride a registered epic_bug_screen_verdict schema with normalizing validator (mirroring overlap_verdict idiom); verifier receives show_ticket for store-grounded disposition adjudication; screen failure degrades open, never blocks.

Screen tally and unevaluated-overflow count recorded in the completion sidecar; regression fixtures cover must-block (30a2, 5b09), must-pass (30d3, e6a0, c8ed), and documented-unreachable cases; live calibration validates real model path and disposition rule end-to-end.
